answer: At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a karst tag. The grove cap is policed at intake and orchard makes public the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch however much capital it holds, since each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 3 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
